main_body: Market stall: striped awning on top, produce shelf behind, and a wooden counter with a front panel on a stone base
top_band: Striped awning (green/cream) at rows 0-11, a lighter brown counter-top band at rows ~26-29 with produce on it, then the front face from row ~30
evidence: Column x~20: the awning band (rows 0-11) is a lighter roof surface over a dark eave shadow (rows 12-14). The counter has a lighter top band at rows ~26-29 with an orange edge highlight where it meets the darker front face (rows 30-41, with a centre seam). The stone base is at row 42. The counter top is only about 4 rows and the front panels are flat rather than inset, but the structure matches the stall reference: a roof band plus a counter-top band above a front face. This is marginally 3/4.

style.evidence: The awning has several greens plus cream, and the wood has 4-5 browns with grain speckle and a plank seam. The produce is shaded with highlights. Outlines are dark brown or purple-brown tinted to the material rather than neutral black. The lower counter front is a fairly large, plain wood area with only light speckle, so density is a little below the reference, but it sits acceptably beside the stall reference.
